name: ViolationList
intent: A selectable list of violations, used by any panel that offers a way into a ticket.
when: A panel lists violations that drill into their full ticket

commonMistakes.mistake: Re-implementing the row markup in each panel that lists violations
commonMistakes.fix: Use ViolationList so a camera's catch and a responder's queue cannot drift apart
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Copy the row markup between panels

lineage.confidence: unset — exercised through both panels in the browser

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use ViolationList to display structured data or visualizations. This component helps users understand and interact with complex information sets.

ViolationList is ideal for dashboards, reports, and data-heavy interfaces. Ensure data is presented clearly and consider responsive behavior for different screen sizes. Provide appropriate loading states for async data.

anatomy.description: ViolationList is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use consistent item spacing
bestPractices.description: Maintain uniform gaps between list items for visual rhythm.

bestPractices.title: Don't vary item spacing
bestPractices.description: Avoid inconsistent gaps that create visual confusion.

bestPractices.title: Provide loading states
bestPractices.description: Show skeleton loaders while list data is being fetched.

bestPractices.title: Don't show empty state unexpectedly
bestPractices.description: Always indicate loading vs empty to avoid confusing users.

bestPractices.title: Support keyboard navigation
bestPractices.description: Enable arrow key navigation through list items.

bestPractices.title: Don't break navigation flow
bestPractices.description: Avoid interactive elements that trap focus within items.
